# llms.txt — AI-Workflow

> This file describes the repository structure for LLM tools and AI coding agents.
> Convention: https://llmstxt.org

## Project

- **Name**: AI-Workflow
- **Owner**: dmageyev
- **Purpose**: Template repository for multi-agent work with a "consciousness transfer" (handoff) protocol.
- **Language policy**: Content in Ukrainian; file names, YAML keys, technical terms in English.

## Key entry points

- `README.md` — project overview and usage instructions
- `.ai/start_promt.md` — bootstrap prompt for new repo / new work cycle
- `.ai/start_guide.md` — instructions for using the start prompt
- `.ai/create-repo-prompt.md` — prompt to reproduce this structure in a new repository
- `.ai/docs/05-agent-requests.md` — how to structure requests to agents

## AI agent configuration

- `.ai/agents/registry.yaml` — agent registry (roles, prompt files)
- `.ai/prompts/system/` — system prompts for all roles
- `.ai/prompts/tasks/` — task prompts (create-plan, implement-feature, review, debug)
- `.ai/prompts/handoff/` — handoff package templates

## Project state (canonical)

- `.ai/memory/state/project-state.yaml` — current phase, progress, work items
- `.ai/logs/sessions/` — session history (Handoff Packages: snapshot.yaml + handoff.md)

## Knowledge base

- `.ai/memory/glossary.uk.md` — project glossary
- `.ai/memory/knowledge/` — domain notes and research findings
- `.ai/memory/decisions/` — Architecture Decision Records (ADR)

## Documentation

- `.ai/docs/00-vision.md` — project vision
- `.ai/docs/01-architecture.md` — multi-agent system architecture
- `.ai/docs/02-workflow.md` — session lifecycle and operational model
- `.ai/docs/03-handoff-protocol.md` — handoff protocol specification
- `.ai/docs/04-quality-gates.md` — quality checklists (session close, handoff, ADR)
- `.ai/docs/05-agent-requests.md` — how to make requests to agents

## Workflows

- `.ai/workflows/runbook.uk.md` — operational runbook
- `.ai/workflows/examples/example-handoff.md` — annotated handoff example

## CI

- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` — Markdown lint (markdownlint) + YAML lint (yamllint)
- `.markdownlint.json` — markdownlint config (120-char line limit)
- `.yamllint.yml` — yamllint config
